name: Away Team
description:
About This Game

Mistakenly shipped off on a research rocket, you find yourself in a strange new world where you must take control of the simulation to survive and thrive.

The world reacts to your every action. Harness chemical reactions, fine-grained temperature simulation and convection, liquids that evaporate, and more.

You will need to design and construct solutions to process, refine and build your way out of this ordeal in order to survive and complete your mission imperatives.

Oh, and maybe a little oxygen is included.

Manipulate the World

Maybe you weren't expecting to be here, but you're resourceful. Create your own abode in this new world, generating power, food, and oxygen to survive and thrive.

Real time Gas, Liquid and Heat Simulation

Water flows and evaporates, fire requires oxygen to burn, and every tile simulates thermal capacity and conductivity. Use the simulation to your advantage to build a dynamic base, or ignore it at your peril.

Farm with Style

Every element in the game reacts to its environment. Use dirt, seeds and water to create your farm, and manipulate the simulation to optimize your output.
short_desc: Away Team is a new Oxygen Not Included game. Mistakenly shipped off to an alien world, you will need to harness the environment and master temperature, pressure, chemical reactions and more in order to survive, and possibly, thrive.
